text.p: Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc said on Monday that it maintained its offer for all of the common shares of Silcorp Ltd at C$16.50 a share.

Couche-Tard said it was prepared to extend the offer until 9 a.m. EDT October 21, subject to reserving its right to consider Silcorp's transaction with Becker Milk Co to be a material adverse change in the affairs of Silcorp.
Couche-Tard said it considers Silcorp's proposed acquisition of Becker Milk to be imprudent from Silcorp's perspective.

"We are concerned with the process, timing, price and certain terms of the proposed Beckers transaction, including the provision prohibiting Beckers from tendering its 950,000 Silcorp common shares except pursuant to a takeover bid approved by Silcorp's board," said Couche-Tard president and chief executive Alain Bouchard in a statement.

Couche-Tard said that after the close of trading on September 27, it had presented an offer to Silcorp's board of directors to acquire all of Silcorp's common shares at C$18.50 a share. The offer was subject to certain conditions, including waiver of Silcorp's shareholder rights plan, Couche-Tard being provided with access to Silcorp's data rooms, the support of Silcorp's board and a break-up fee of C$0.50 a share.
Couche-Tard said it received no response from Silcorp's board on the proposal, which expired at 9 a.m. EDT Monday.
